```

ESC [ B   → Move the cursor down one line
```

When these bytes reach a terminal that understands ANSI control codes, the cursor will jump up one line and then immediately back down one line. In most chat interfaces (including this one) those escape characters are treated as ordinary text, so you won’t see any visual effect—just the literal characters “[A[B” appear. If you intended to move the cursor in a real terminal, you’d need to send those bytes directly to the terminal device.
